correctness.rationale: PASS: Orthogonal monomial norms yield b_nk=(n+1)/(n+k+1) sqrt(w_n(beta)/w_k(alpha)). Tonelli converts the k sum to S_n=integral_0^1 t^n(-log t)(1-t)^(-alpha-2)dt. The explicit beta sandwich B(n+1,-alpha)<=S_n<=B(n+1,-alpha)+(1/2)B(n,1-alpha) and uniform gamma ratios yield E_n=C_alpha(delta)(n+1)^(-1-delta)+O_alpha((n+1)^(-2-delta)) uniformly 0<=delta<=1/2. The absolute errors are summable uniformly; integral comparisons give logarithmic critical mass and 1/delta total mass. For every s>=0, sum to floor(exp(s/delta)) differs from (1-exp(-s))/delta by O(1) uniformly even when s=0 or huge, proving Kolmogorov O_alpha(delta). Independent scipy quadrature confirmed asymptotic row factors for n=5..500, delta=0,.1,.2; finite checks only supplement proof.
